findings.title: Duplicate debug text banner
findings.where: Arena, top-center — the second dark panel stacked directly under the "Practice arena —" instruction banner
findings.problem: The second box shows a garbled repeated token dump ("a1IceSeedSeedSeed...") instead of a coherent message, looking like a raw variable printed to screen
findings.why: It reads as a crash/dev leftover on the first screen a player sees in-game, breaking the illusion that the game is finished and undermining the arena's introduction
findings.fix: Remove the second panel entirely; if the seed must be visible, print it once as a tidy mono line inside the main banner (e.g. "Seed: a1Ice... · Press F1 to copy") rather than repeating raw tokens

findings.title: Radar with no sweep or contacts
findings.where: Arena and road, bottom-left RADAR panel
findings.problem: The panel is a black disc with a single dim radial line, a center dot, and range rings, but no moving sweep glow and zero contacts, so it looks dead
findings.why: At speed and with a noisy scene the player cannot tell it is an instrument instead of a broken widget; an empty radar should still read as a functioning gauge
findings.fix: Animate a rotating sweep with a faint trailing glow, add subtle range rings and a north marker, and raise the panel border/contrast so the disc reads as a live instrument even when blank; later, render contacts as bright blips

findings.title: Giant dashed debug circle
findings.where: City, a thick white dashed ring spanning almost the entire frame over the ground
findings.problem: A huge dashed white boundary circle dominates the view with no legend and no solid wall geometry behind it, exactly like a development overlay
findings.why: It cheapens the open-world first impression, distracts from the buildings, and makes the city feel like an unclosed test zone rather than a place
findings.fix: Convert it to a subtle map edge: mute the dash color to low-opacity gray, replace the circle with low-opacity glow plus proper wall/gate geometry at the entry points, and add labeled gates matching the on-screen entry instructions

findings.title: Empty constructor schematic and blank weapon rows
findings.where: Constructor, right-side top-view panel (featureless neon outline with two empty slot rectangles) and left parts list (Weapon 1–10 all "(empty)")
findings.problem: The top-view shows only a glowing outline and empty slot boxes, with no mounted hardware, yet the footer claims "6 mounted"; the weapon rows have only text and no visible add affordance
findings.why: The player cannot visualize or verify their build, so the constructor feels like a placeholder screen right when they should be excited about their vehicle
findings.fix: Draw equipped parts as small scaled icons inside the schematic rectangles so the view repaints as parts are added, and put a visible "+" add affordance on each empty weapon row instead of relying on the tiny help line alone

findings.title: Invisible courier progress bar
findings.where: Road, top-center hairline track just under the "En route to Albany — 150mi remaining" caption
findings.problem: The progress indicator is a thin dark line with a single tiny white tick and no proportional fill, so it carries almost no visual information
findings.why: Courier distance-progress is core gameplay feedback, and at highway speed with a small HUD the player cannot see how far they have come or how close Albany is
findings.fix: Replace it with a thicker bright bar (full width of the caption, cyan or white) that fills proportionally to distance remaining and carries a moving chevron marker; keep the caption text above it
